notes:
- Network: the main computer no longer shuts down while others are working; the database closes only after 10 minutes with no activity on any computer, and the program stays open so others can continue once the owner signs in again
- Network: other computers lock after 10 minutes without activity, as the status bar shows
- Down payment and installments: choose "Excluded" (the rest is split into installments, the down payment is its own closed line) or "Included"; Excluded is the default
- Transaction categories can be linked to a project family: choosing the category fills in the family's current project
- Project family codes use the first letter and the following consonants (General → GNL); a second project in the same year gets -02
- Projects report: Profit / Loss and Collection performance are shown as tabs
- Transfers: ready-made choices for paying the credit card (from bank, cash or POS) and moving money from the card to cash, bank or POS
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
